## Rule

Color-5 cells form horizontal and vertical line segments on a 10x10 grid. Compute each row's
maximum contiguous horizontal 5-run and each column's maximum contiguous vertical 5-run. Rank
the distinct positive lengths globally: longest -> color 1, second-longest -> color 4, all
remaining positive lengths -> color 2. Each 5-cell with a vertical neighbor uses its column
rank; otherwise it uses its row rank. Background remains color 0.

## Algorithm sketch

```python
mask = grid == 5
h_len = [max_contiguous_ones(mask[r, :]) for r in range(10)]
v_len = [max_contiguous_ones(mask[:, c]) for c in range(10)]
ranked = sorted({*h_len, *v_len} - {0}, reverse=True)

for each cell (r, c):
    if not mask[r, c]: out[r, c] = 0
    elif (r > 0 and mask[r-1, c]) or (r < 9 and mask[r+1, c]):
        out[r, c] = rank_color(v_len[c], ranked)
    else:
        out[r, c] = rank_color(h_len[r], ranked)
```

ONNX v1 computes each row/column as a 10-bit F16 code, casts to INT64, and gathers from an
exact 1024-entry max-run LUT. The rank tail is UINT8 and the final output is BOOL one-hot,
padded to the 30x30 NeuroGolf output frame.

## Cost analysis

Previous best candidate: `conv_run_combined` at cost 36315 (memory=35324, params=991).
Memory dominates (97.3%). The 4 Conv weights are (9,1,1,10)×2 + (9,1,10,1)×2 F16 = 720+720+720+720=2880 bytes params (plus conv_thresh 18 bytes). Peak activation: (1,9,10,19) F16 per Conv output ≈ 3,420 bytes × 4 directions = ~14k of the 35k memory.

Live cost was 78031 (memory=77404, params=627). The Pad+Slice+Mul chains generated large (1,1,10,10) F16 intermediates per step × 9 steps × 4 directions = huge activation memory.

New best exact candidate: `task374_v8` at cost 2831 (memory=2792, params=39). It uses the ARC-GEN
invariant that every object is a non-overlapping horizontal/vertical segment of length >=2:
same-orientation neighbor scores sum to `2L-2`, which preserves the length ranking while
avoiding the max-run LUT. v6 switched local neighbor sums from F16 Conv to UINT8 QLinearConv;
v7/v8 trimmed scalar params. Largest remaining intermediates:

| tensor | dtype/shape | bytes |
|---|---:|---:|
| `label30` | UINT8 `[1,1,30,30]` | 900 |
| `ch5_f32` | F32 `[1,1,10,10]` | 400 |
| `hmask_f16`, `vmask_f16` | F16 `[1,1,10,10]` each | 400 total |
| `ch5`, `h_neigh_sum`, `v_neigh_sum`, `hmask_u8`, `vmask_u8` | UINT8 `[1,1,10,10]` each | 500 total |
| `ch5_present`, `has_v_neighbor`, `chosen_rank`, `label` | BOOL/UINT8 `[1,1,10,10]` each | 400 total |

Sub-1000 exact is blocked by current accounting: the sentinel-padded label needed before final
one-hot expansion is 900 B by itself, and the cheapest verified crop-collapse of color-5 emits
a 400 B F32 10x10 tensor before any line/rank logic. A different final-output convention or a
scorer loophole would be needed to get below 1000; no locally verifying exact graph can fit that
budget with these tensors present.

## Don't-do log

- Do NOT apply conv_run to the live canonical if crop_f16out is already staged: the combined candidate (conv_run on crop_f16out, cost 36315) is strictly better than conv_run from live (cost 66303).
- The standalone `conv_run_t_aafe9a9c` candidate (66303) is superseded by `conv_run_combined_t_b00c9aba` (36315); discard the former.
- Do NOT rank per-cell `bar_len` as the rule. The verified rule ranks distinct row/column max
  segment lengths globally, then applies column rank only to cells with a vertical neighbor.
- Do NOT use row/column raw counts as a replacement for contiguous/oriented length. It matches
  only 187/267 official pairs and 154786/200000 corpus pairs; first official failures are caused
  by perpendicular singleton cells sharing a row/column with a true segment.
- Do NOT spend time on `code % M` compression for the v1/v2 10-bit max-run LUT. On the 200k
  saturated code set (427 observed row/column patterns), plain modulo needs M=1023 and simple
  multiply/xor-shift modulo searches found no useful smaller collision-safe table.
- For sub-1000 attempts, account for the hard tensors first: `label30` is 900 B and `ch5_f32`
  is 400 B. Any exact path that materializes both is already over budget before ranking.
- `ConstantOfShape` all-zero risk probe was rejected by `score_network_v2`; use `Expand(false_scalar, shape)`
  if a tiny all-zero public-weight probe is deliberately desired.
- Unmasked neighbor-score rank (summing neighbor counts over whole rows/columns without center masking)
  is not exact: 232/267 official, 181960/200000 corpus. Do not stage as a correctness candidate.
